strNotes: Shared construction, machinery controls, transfers, translations, crew orders and training for Phobos mods. Install with the content mods that require it. Orders begin disabled; supplies, space, power, crew needs and access still matter. Saved-state faults stop affected work for inspection. Requires BepInEx 5 and the PhobosFramework plugin; no Shipbreaker, Crafting Framework or Salvage Workshop dependency. Optional Phobos Scope performance recording starts off. Development candidate; in-game evaluation pending.
